products.name: Articos MCP
products.tagline: See how simulated buyers react, right in your agent
products.description: Most teams ship, then hope it lands. Articos MCP lets you check first. Right inside Claude or ChatGPT, run your headlines, positioning, or pages past simulated buyers based on your actual customers, and see how they respond before it goes out. Validated against human research from Baymard and Nielsen Norman, it agrees 86% of the time.

products.name: OpenCode 2.0
products.tagline: The open source AI coding agent
products.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It’s available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or web app.

products.name: Fina Business
products.tagline: The flexible $20/mo QuickBooks alternative for founders
products.description: You started a business, not an accounting department. Fina Business gives founders the essentials of business accounting without the complexity of traditional tools. Track business and personal finances your way, automate invoices, accept Stripe payments, manage customers, and get double-entry bookkeeping, P&L, and balance sheets. Start at $20/mo and customize Fina around how your business actually works.

products.name: Muse Wonder
products.tagline: Meta’s most capable models for personal agents
products.description: Muse Wonder is Meta’s new model series for personal and professional agents, with two models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Active Memory carries your context across conversations, Active Focus keeps working through blockers on hard goals, and it adds domain expertise in law, finance, and health plus stronger coding. Muse Wonder is live on the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers.

products.name: Kai
products.tagline: Autonomous assistant designed to handle meetings and email
products.description: Kai is an AI executive assistant for solopreneurs, freelancers and startup founders. It works across your email, calendar and tasks: it triages your inbox and drafts replies, schedules around your availability, records and transcribes your meetings, then turns them into summaries and action items. Workflows run in the background, and Kai hands tasks to Claude or ChatGPT with the context of the meeting or email they came from. Web, desktop and mobile. Product Hunt sign-ups get 2x trial credits.

products.name: MentionBird
products.description: We took the top 3 Product Hunt launches and asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude the exact questions their buyers ask: “Best browser for Claude Code?” “How do I track agent run costs?” “Best open-source Grok alternative?” Nine answers. Zero mentions. AI sent their buyers elsewhere. That’s how AI search works. It pulls from pages it trusts—listicles, Reddit, comparisons, YouTube. If you’re not there, you’re not in the answer. MentionBird helps you fix that.

products.name: MausBot
products.tagline: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local
products.description: Give each bot a job and work with it in a familiar chat interface. MausBot brings your supported AI agents together on your computer, with tools and routines for getting work done. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Bring your own provider account or API key; provider fees and limits apply.

products.name: Takes for Mac
products.tagline: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit.
products.description: A free, open-source Mac app for talking-head videos. A teleprompter that follows your voice, one-button recording of camera and screen, and every take in plain folders. Claude Code, on your own Claude plan, cuts the edit, makes the vertical version and drafts the posts. Leave notes on the frame; it turns them into rules and remembers them.

products.name: PostNitro for Agents
products.tagline: Let your AI agent design and publish social posts
products.description: Most social APIs let an agent publish text or media it already has. PostNitro lets it design the post too. Connect from Claude or ChatGPT in one click (OAuth, no API key), or use our 35-tool MCP server, CLI or REST API. Your agent turns a topic, article or X thread into an on-brand carousel, image post or animated video, then schedules it to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Facebook and Pinterest. Or it hands you an editable draft to finish.

products.name: Toby
products.tagline: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager
products.description: Paste a job description. Toby researches the company, maps every round and interviews you on a Meet, Teams or Zoom-style call. Then you get a scored debrief and a stronger version of each answer, built only from what you said. Real mode runs it straight through; Coach mode gives a note and a retry. No subscription: 50p a minute on a call. First 5 minutes free.

products.name: Genchi
products.tagline: Project delivery predictions, from the people doing the work
products.description: Genchi shows engineering leaders a prediction of which projects are heading for a missed deadline and which aren't, from the people doing the work. We've rebuilt it from the ground up. Team members vote with one anonymous click in Slack. Leaders see a combined score for every and trend in one portfolio view, so they know where to step in and which teams to leave alone. Genchi works with Jira and Asana. You can see your live portfolio inside Claude, ChatGPT and Grok. Free for teams of up to 10.

products.name: OpenWhispr for iOS
products.tagline: 100% open source, free & on device transcription
products.description: 100% open source, with local models that run on your iPhone or iPad. Transcribe on-device for free, without usage limits, an account or a subscription. Speak your reply, draft an email or capture an idea without uploading your audio for transcription. Download a model once and transcribe offline. Choose optional cloud processing or bring your own API key.

products.name: Servor
products.tagline: One console to run and monitor all your servers
products.description: One console for every server you run: web terminal, file editor, scheduled jobs, fleet-wide commands, 150+ install recipes, plus monitoring, phone alerts and status pages. No open port, and every command is signed in your browser.

products.name: vibesmonitor.com
products.tagline: The ops center for everything you ship
products.description: Vibesmonitor puts traffic, errors, user feedback and cookie consent for every project you ship on one screen, with an inbox of what needs you first. One script per site. Or ask Claude, Cursor or any MCP agent which project needs you today.

products.name: Google Fitbit Edge
products.tagline: Google’s smartest fitness tracker ever with 7-day battery
products.description: Fitbit Edge is Google’s slim, screen-based fitness tracker for active lifestyles and everyday wear. It has built-in GPS, over 50 workout modes, ECG, skin temperature, and up to seven days of battery per Google. It’s Fitbit’s first repairable tracker, with a replaceable battery. $179.99, pre-order now, on shelves Oct 27. Includes 3 months of Google Health Premium, which is needed for the Health Coach and Health Guardian.
